{{Top|leg}}
A '''force-field generator''' was a generator that made a [[Force field/Legends|force field]]. The force field could be used for various purposes, including security (keeping beings from entering the field) and shielding.

The [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] was equipped with one of these generators.
